text:
She writes

continually

like a long sprayer

spraying

the air,

and argues

continually;

there is nothing

I can say

that is not really

something else,

then,

I stop talking;

and finally

she argues with herself

outside the door

saying

something like

I am not trying to

impress myself

through you.


but I know

she will be

back, they always

come back.


and

at 5 p.m.

she was knocking at the door.

I let her in


I won't stay long, she said,

if you don't want me to.

it's all right, I said,

I'm going to take a

bath.


she went to the kitchen and

started on the

dishes.


like being married,

you accept

everything

as if it had

been that way.

translation.title: She Writes...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the domestic loop of argument, return, dishes, and resignation.
